title: Florida Yachts International Welcomes Yachting New Yorkers
html:
Florida Yachts International is leading the way in attracting New Yorker’s as the one-stop-shop for yachting needs in Miami.

Without a doubt, Miami is one of the hottest cities in the world. Boasting world-class entertainment, real estate, yachting and an incredibly colorful lifestyle, Miami is quickly becoming New Yorkers’ top lifestyle destination vacation spot, and even becoming their home.

After all, what contrasts better with the hustle & bustle of New York than the vibrant & glamorous Miami lifestyle?

For years New Yorkers have been coming to Miami, but that crowd is now expanding. What used to be retirees looking to get away from the cold New York winters has now become young professionals looking to both live and work in Miami.

After all, what does Miami have to offer, and why are so many New Yorkers heading to Miami? While there are many factors, including the warm weather and great business environment, one of the more leisurely reasons just so happens to be the Yachting Lifestyle.

Florida Yachts International was recently recognized as the “Number One Yacht Charter Company” in Miami offering the most luxurious yachting experiences in Miami, Fort Lauderdale and the Bahamas. From a weeklong trip in the Exumas, to a day out on the water in Miami, Florida Yachts International will make it happen.

There’s no better way to get to know Miami than by chartering a yacht, choices are endless features all size and ranges.

Spend a day at one of Miami’s famous sandbars or charter a 100 ft. luxury superyacht for a week in the Bahamas. The experience is catered to your taste and budget for the absolute best one can experience on the water. After all, memories are one of the very few things we truly own.

Whether you’re looking to purchase, sell or charter, New Yorkers are invited to become a part of the FYI Family that keeps growing and making all your yachting dreams come true.

If you’re interested in becoming part of the yachting lifestyle, Florida Yachts International & Ralph Navarro would love to hear from you. You can email FYI’s experienced brokerage team at: sales@fyiyachts.com or give them a call: (305) 204-3613
